select cls, (fish_date_doy/30)::int as month_bucket, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 61 and 121
group by 1,2 order by 2,1

select boat, cls, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and cls='overnight' and fish_date_doy between 88 and 110
group by 1,2 order by yt desc

select boat, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and cls='three_quarter' and fish_date_doy between 90 and 121
group by 1 order by yt desc limit 15
select index_id, value, avail_doy from climate where avail_season=2 order by avail_doy desc limit 8

select cls, boat, fish_date_doy, anglers, yt
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 116 and 121 and yt>0
order by fish_date_doy, cls, yt desc

select cls, boat, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 110 and 121
group by 1,2 having sum(yt)>0
order by yt desc

select cls, boat, fish_date_doy
from schedule
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 122 and 135 and cls in ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
order by fish_date_doy, cls, boat

select fish_date_doy, cls, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy in (118,119,120,121)
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select cls, min(fish_date_doy) mind, max(fish_date_doy) maxd, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy>=120 and fish_date_doy<150
group by 1 order by 1

select cls, (fish_date_doy/30)::int as month_bucket, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 61 and 121
group by 1,2 order by 2,1

select fish_date_doy, count(*) from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 61 and 121 and (fish_date_doy/30)::int=4
group by 1 order by 1
SELECT * FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT cls, count(*) n_trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT landing, count(*) n_trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='THREE_QUARTER' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121
GROUP BY landing ORDER BY yt DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT landing, count(*) n_trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='three_quarter' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121
GROUP BY landing ORDER BY yt DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT landing, fish_date_doy, anglers, yt FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121 ORDER BY fish_date_doy
SELECT * FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='three_quarter' AND landing='seaforth' ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT boat, count(*) n, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) ypa, max(fish_date_doy) last_day
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='three_quarter' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121
GROUP BY boat ORDER BY yt DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT boat, count(*) n, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 121
GROUP BY boat ORDER BY yt DESC
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 AND index_id IN ('oni','sst_pier','temp_pier') ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 6
